changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE nightly_request_sources ( day DATE NOT NULL, username TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, cutoff TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, requests JSONB, error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (day, username), CHECK ((requests IS NULL) <> (error IS NULL)), CHECK (requests IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(requests) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(requests) = 50)) ); CREATE INDEX idx_log_entry_recent_full_user ON log_entry(user_id, timestamp_request DESC, id DESC) WHERE privacy_level = 'FULL' AND result_status = 'success' AND input_payload IS NOT NULL AND environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'model-provider-benchmark';

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX idx_log_entry_recent_full_user; DROP TABLE nightly_request_sources;
